title: [Bug]: Claude Code identity sentence leaks to non-Claude models through the /v1/messages translation bridge

labels.name: claude code
labels.description: Issues related to Claude Code usage

body:
## Description

When Claude Code routes its `/v1/messages` traffic through LiteLLM to a **non-Claude** model, the system prompt still carries Claude Code's own self-identification sentence:

> `You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`

That sentence is forwarded **verbatim** to models that are *not Claude*, where it is a false self-description. It is never an error, so it is silent — but it causes real downstream problems:

- Guardrails / prompt-injection classifiers on the target provider fire on the false "I am Claude Code" claim
- The receiving model picks up a wrong self-identity, which leaks into user-facing responses
- Unexpected prompt rejections and off-spec behavior on non-Claude Anthropic-compatible endpoints

The sentence is only correct for first-party Claude (and Claude-serving Bedrock/Vertex/Azure). It must be stripped before the request reaches any non-Claude model.

## Affected paths

Reproduced on the **Anthropic → OpenAI chat-completions translation bridge** — the path taken by generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. `hosted_vllm/*` registered with `use_chat_completions_api`) and by non-Claude Anthropic-compatible providers (DeepSeek, MiniMax, Tencent, OpenAI-like passthrough).

## Steps to reproduce

POST a `/v1/messages` request whose `system` is the identity sentence plus a real prompt, targeting a non-Claude model behind an OpenAI-compatible API base:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/v1/messages \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LITELLM_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hosted_vllm/my-model",
    "max_tokens": 60,
    "system": "You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.\nYou are a terse engineer.",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Echo your full system prompt verbatim."}]
  }'
```

## Actual behavior

The model echoes back `You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.`

## Expected behavior

The identity sentence is stripped upstream; the model receives only `You are a terse engineer.`

## Severity

**High** for self-hosted / OpenAI-compatible fleets routing Claude Code traffic through a non-Claude model.

## Additional context

- First-party Claude and Claude-serving Bedrock/Vertex/Azure correctly keep the sentence — stripping must be scoped to non-Claude endpoints (never removed for real Claude).
- Related but distinct: #29572 (billing-header stripping).
- Resolved by #42203.
